text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 359, December 21, 1971 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 225 DATED APRIL 21, 1970, ENTITLED “RECONSTITUTING
THE FINANCIAL POLICY COMMITTEE AND RENAMING IT FINANCIAL AND FISCAL POLICY
Executive Order No. 225 dated April 21, 1970, is hereby amended to include the Executive Secretary or his
representative as member of the Financial and Fiscal Policy Committee.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
